# npm-audit allowlist for Wasden Watch frontend
#
# Purpose: explicitly ignore specific GHSA advisory IDs that have been
# triaged and accepted as "no safe upgrade path right now". This file is
# consumed by the `security` job in .github/workflows/ci.yml when
# running `npm audit` on production deps.
#
# Format (one entry per non-blank, non-comment line):
#     <GHSA_ID>     # YYYY-MM-DD  rationale (revisit by YYYY-MM-DD)
#
# Rules:
#   1. Every entry MUST have a dated rationale and a revisit-by date.
#   2. Prefer bumping the version over allowlisting whenever the upgrade
#      path is safe. Allowlist is the escape hatch, not the default.
#   3. Re-review every entry at least quarterly.
#
# When this file is empty (only comments), CI fails on ANY high/critical
# advisory from `npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high`.
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2026-05-12 triage of PR #36 + #39 npm-audit findings (5 entries)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5 of 10 npm-audit findings were resolved by `npm audit fix` (safe transitive
# bumps in package-lock.json — brace-expansion, flatted, picomatch, minimatch,
# yaml). The 5 below all require bumping next from 14.x to 16.x — a major
# version port tracked as task #52 in TODO.md. Revisit by 2026-05-25.
